headlines.title: State Street Consumer Staples SPDR (XLP) Sells Walmart and Costco on Nov. 6
headlines.summary: The fund sold $144.2 million of stock, cutting all 33 positions, with $16.3 million of Walmart and $13.6 million of Costco leading the exits.

headlines.title: ETFs Bought $69.5 Million of Costco (COST) on Friday
headlines.summary: 49 ETFs bought Costco shares versus 15 that sold on Friday, Nov. 6.

headlines.title: Costco Wholesale (COST) Gains Grocery Share As Its Valuation Looks Harder To Ignore
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) has just overtaken Kroger in a key grocery market share ranking, as warehouse expansion, digital sales growth, and partnerships like NationsBenefits draw more everyday food spending into its membership model. Recent moves in Costco Wholesale’s share price back up that story. The stock trades at US$1,066.18 after a 1-day share price return of 1.20%, a 30-day share price return of 12.59%, and a year-to-date share price return of 24.77%.

headlines.title: Costco just passed Kroger in a grocery ranking that matters
headlines.summary: The numbers don’t lie: Shoppers are choosing Costco for a very specific reason.

headlines.title: She Plans to Join Costco’s New Medicare Advantage Plan at 65. Once Her 12-Month Trial Right Ends, a Medigap Insurer Could Ask Health Questions and Reject Her Application
headlines.summary: A $0 premium and a trusted warehouse brand make Costco's new Medicare Advantage plan an easy yes at 65. The fine print on getting out of it, and a clock that starts on day one, could turn an easy yes into a costly trap.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising consumer electronics, appliances, small electrics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, food courts, optical, hearing aids, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. Further, the company operates e-commerce sites; and offers branded and private-label products in various categories. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
